feature.name: pytest mark expression evaluator
feature.description: Extract pytest -m mark expression compile/evaluate logic as a standalone package.
included_behaviors: parse and compile mark expressions with and/or/not
evaluate expressions against a matcher callback
support identifier kwargs syntax for parameterized markers
excluded_behaviors: full pytest collection and test running
CLI, original tests, docs, packaging metadata

entanglement.description: Mark expressions compile to Python bytecode evaluated against pytest marker matching hooks.
signals: MatcherAdapter bridges eval() to marker names
used by pytest -m but standalone logic lives in one module

output.import: from featurelifted import Expression, ParseError; from featurelifted import expression; from featurelifted.expression import Scanner, TokenType

public_spec.title: pytest mark expression evaluator
public_spec.summary: Extract a task-scoped subset of `pytest` into a standalone `featurelifted` package.

behaviors.text: The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: parse and compile mark expressions with and/or/not. Required observable cases include kwargs matcher.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: evaluate expressions against a matcher callback. Required observable cases include and or logic; kwargs matcher; expression module scanner.
The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: support identifier kwargs syntax for parameterized markers. Required observable cases include kwargs matcher.
The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: empty expression evaluates to False. Required observable cases include empty expression is false; and or logic; expression module scanner.

The package exposes the required task API paths `featurelifted.Expression`, `featurelifted.Expression.compile`, `featurelifted.Expression.evaluate`, `featurelifted.ParseError`, `featurelifted.expression`, `featurelifted.expression.Scanner`, `featurelifted.expression.Scanner.current`, `featurelifted.expression.TokenType`, `featurelifted.expression.TokenType.IDENT` with the kinds and callable signatures listed in this contract.

exclusions: full pytest collection and test running
CLI, original tests, docs, packaging metadata
